parameters.name: DbInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the destination RDS instance.

parameters.name: EstimatedSize
parameters.description: The estimated data size, in GB.

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: The IP address of the source MySQL database. RDS accesses this IP address to obtain a backup.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password for the source MySQL user. It must be Base64-encoded.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port of the source MySQL database.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~610399~~) operation to query the latest region list.

parameters.name: SourceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the cloud instance that hosts the source database.

parameters.name: SourcePlatform
parameters.description: The type of the cloud instance that hosts the source database.

parameters.name: StreamPort
parameters.description: The streaming port used to transfer the backup.

parameters.name: User
XtrabackupPath
parameters.description: The installation path of xtrabackup on the source server.
